description.en: Enables the map's lighting setup for the given map handle (used after loading/switching to a map, before its lights should take effect).
Handle of the map, from CMND_GET_MAP_HANDLE.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Enable lighting for the current map
CMND_ENABLE_MAP_LIGHT(CMND_GET_MAP_HANDLE());
